title: Neywa Labs Launches Tool to Run Private AI Offline on Existing Hardware
summary:
The startup Neywa Labs has emerged from stealth mode to provide infrastructure that allows artificial intelligence to operate without cloud connectivity. The technology is designed to run on the hardware users already own, enabling the deployment of AI that is private and fully offline.

The company said the launch of the platform is intended to broaden global access to AI tools by removing dependency on external servers and internet access.
